content.subject: Quick thought on month-end close
content.draft_text:
Hi Jon,
You announced your new CFO role in a Global FinTech Q&A. Month-end close often stalls when teams match data manually across systems, adding hours of repetitive work.
We build bots that pull transaction data from each ledger and reconcile it automatically.
Can we schedule a brief call next week to explore?
Zamp
